user_verbatim:
как можем улучшить обучение? мне кажется лучше не теория а практика
может создадим игру по этому предмету и я буду ее проходить? что скажешь?
decision: Prepare a one-decision game pilot for feedback. Practice-first with concise theory after the own decision. Preserve existing 14 stages and 42 blocks. Full game not yet built or accepted as final format.

pilot.title: Change Manager — The lunch rush
pilot.case_type: fictional teaching scenario; possible consequences, not empirical predictions
pilot.mechanism: Explore evidence; choose an intervention; give a reason; then receive one conditional consequence and optional chat debrief. Three defensible interventions with tradeoffs, no invented business scores.
pilot.language: simple adult English; optional short Russian help
pilot.tested: Headless Chrome: all 3 decisions, no answer revealed before own attempt, evidence/help controls, verbatim rationale, follow-up fallback, 360px no horizontal overflow, no script errors.

progress_rule: Clicks and game completion do not prove mastery. Own explanation, new transfer case and delayed recall remain required. Game episodes must map to curriculum blocks.
